name: mcp-streamable-http-client-no-sdk
description: Call an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over Streamable HTTP from your own code without the MCP SDK - just an HTTP client that can POST and read a body. Use when: (1) you need to list or call a remote MCP server's tools from a runtime where pulling the official SDK and its asyncio stack is not worth it for a couple of calls; (2) a server exposes only an MCP endpoint (a path ending /mcp) and no plain REST; (3) your POST returns an SSE body of lines beginning "data:" instead of a single JSON object and json.loads() fails; (4) tools/list or tools/call appears to return nothing because you read the first SSE frame rather than the result frame, or sent no Accept header the server honors; (5) a tools/call result looks empty because content is a list of typed parts you did not join. Covers the initialize -> tools/list -> tools/call sequence, the SSE framing, optional mcp-session-id handling, and isError on an HTTP 200. Includes a dependency-free Python client and the curl equivalent.
